title: Protection
description: Word travels: a stranger is unmaking the Syndicate one racket at a time, and the crews have stopped strolling and started patrolling — Legbreakers with Gunsels at their backs, working the whole High Street in pairs. Good. A frightened Syndicate makes mistakes. The sergeant wants the patrols broken before they learn to hunt in numbers.

objectives.desc: Drop the Gunsels riding shotgun on them
